name: @educateos/commerce
description: EducateOS commerce (roadmap R04): the root control plane's commercial layer. Plans, subscriptions with explicit grace rules, purchase orders, integer-cent invoices (the district's own AI spend is reported, never charged), grant credit ledgers, a payment processor port with a fetch-based Stripe adapter and a fake, signed entitlement issuance for the fleet entitlement cache, verification of fleet registrations, and a hash-chained, append-only finance audit with reconciliation. Every operation commits atomically. Its `./durable-object-store` entry point is the Durable Object SQLite store. A library, not a deployable Worker.
